Well... if the others get hungry, that could be a problem. With Yomi... she'll be fine for a good while.
Y'know, it's not like we have much a choice here. Unless you know where to find Sakaki or Chiyo?
Then ah' guess we betta get goin' with the search for Yomi-chan.
NOOO!!! IF WE DO THAT THE KNUCKLEHEADS WILL BREAK UP AGAIN!

Such a quick but incredible answer...
But of course! I don't even think weight affects gravity...
I don't think I ever would've figured that one out... Leave it to Yomi to give us the answers we need...
Mystery #3: Why are seemingly all of these animals protectin' yall'?
You expect me to know that? I thought I was the only one until just a second ago.
Mystery #4: Who should we save next?
I DON'T KNOW, YA' DAMN WEIRDOS!
Look, all I know is that when I landed up here...
...and it wasn't until it offered me food that I realized it wasn't trying to hurt me.
Are you sure? 'Cause to be fair, you'd trust anyone who gives you food...
Nothing, really. There wasn't much I could do. I didn't know where I was, or what would happen if I tried leaving, so I just stay put.

Do ya' at least have some sorta' idea as to where Sakaki-san or Chiyo-chan mighta' gone?

I just think she's up in the sky.

Well what if I told you that there was one person who was blown upwards...
Yes. Even you should be able to catch on, Tomo.
But I don't get it... How could she be up in the sky for so long?
I think maybe she's being held up by the clouds.
Hey, wait a minute! You of all people should know that you can't stand on clouds!
She's right, Yomi. Clouds ain't nothin' but a buncha' water. It don't make much sense.
True, but nothing makes sense anymore. Didn't you just fight a giant pig that shot out exploding balls of mud?
Hmm... I guess that checks out.
So there's a good chance that Sakaki's being held up in the sky right now...
The only issue is how we're going to get up there...
I know! We can grow a beanstalk and climb it!
I know I just said nothing makes sense, but that's absurd.
You're right. Growing a beanstalk would take too long. I guess we'll just have to use that one over there...
WAS THAT THERE THE WHOLE TIME?!
Really takes the fun outta' growin' it yerself, don't it?
Oh well. It is what it is.
Come on, guys. We might've been protected, but that doesn't mean Sakaki is as well.
I think I'm losing my ability to doubt things...

A few more things! Ya' might get so angry ya' think yer hearin' music!
The music will help ya' tell when yer rage is goin' down! Listen for tha' music!
And one last thing! It takes about 25 seconds for ya' to build up enough rage to activate Osakan Rage again! So use it only when ya' really need it!

Me? But ah' ain't angry enough to use Osakan Rage. I'm scared, if anythin'.

But just as I was about to run away, the large one offered me water.

It was hard, but I told him to leave and go look for everyone else who was kidnapped.
At that point, he was just coming and going. I'm not sure where he left off to, but he always came back to keep me company...
Then, finally, those tigers found Maya. I guess they didn't like having other cats around, because they started getting aggressive with each other right away.
And that's when you guys showed up. When Osaka gave me the pigtails.
That's what gave me a fighting chance to save Maya. I'll never be able to thank you enough.

I GOT IT! I KNOW WHERE TO FIND CHIYO-CHAN!!

Oh yeah! Ah' 'member! That's when ya' slammed me 'n Kagura onta' tha' ground!

Hang on. That's ridiculous! What if they don't have anything to do with Chiyo?
Oh yeah?! Well these last few times you've doubted us you were wrong!
Like with the beanstalk and the Osakan Fury!
Anyways, I know EXACTLY where to find those monkeys!
...Well, I guess there is SOME logic to her reasoning.
Let's go. I'm getting sick of this place.
Well I'm pretty sure this is where I was attacked.
Now why would Chiyo-chan and a couple a' monkeys be in a factory?
Hang on... Let me just ask you guys one thing: isn't this all really weird?
The animals. Something's strange about them. All of them...
I mean, besides their protective tendencies, they've all shown some weird characteristics.
The pig, remember? How it shot those weird mudballs that seemed to do different things?
Or the tiger Sakaki just fought. It found away to attract a nimbus to strike her down with lightning.
Now that I think about it, the kangaroo Osaka fought was spitting fireballs.
Well, as we were walking, I did some thinking, and all of this has made me come to a conclusion...
Someone has to be behind all of this.
Just think about it. Would any of these animals normally be able to do what it is they're doing?
Of course not. Someone HAS to be training them. I believe it was our kidnapper, who sent out these animals to come and get us.
Are you saying the cage blowing up wasn't on purpose?!
Ah' can hardly think of any reason to lock somebody up just ta' blow em' ta' smithereens!
Maybe it's the gorilla behind all of this! There wasn't anything particularly strange about him!
Or maybe there isn't a reason for any of this! Nothing makes sense, after all!
WILL YOU SHUT UP WITH THAT?!
Look, all I'm trying to say is that even if we find Chiyo-chan, there's still a possibility that the animals might come back for us.
And if that's the case, there's no guarantee that the kidnapper would fail to capture us again.
Are you saying we need to find a way to fight back?
It's more like we need to find a way to connect the animals to the kidnapping.
Our main priority right now should be saving Chiyo-chan. If those monkeys really do exist, we're gonna need to be efficient since they'll likely try to kick us out.
That means we're gonna have to help with the search, right?
Right. In that case, Maya should find clues leading to our mastermind.
But we just got him back...
Don't worry. Maya's really strong, and those tigers are gone now. I'm sure he'll have no problems being on his own.
So what kinda' clues're we lookin' for?
If we can find some kind of animal training equipment, or something that could link the animals to a potential mastermind, I think we could work off of that.
And I'm sure Chiyo-chan would have some insight on the kidnapping, another reason we need to find her.
Anyways, I think we should start searching.
Are you okay with letting Maya go for a bit, Sakaki?
...Yeah... Let me see him off first, though.
Maya... As much as I really don't want to do this, we need to split up again.
Are you willing to do this?
You're a good boy, Maya. I hope to see you soon.
We'll see him again soon, Sakaki-san.
Heya, Sakaki, if yer feelin' too sad ta' do anythin, ah' could take those pigtails back if ya' want...
ALRIGHT, LETS GET THIS SHOW ON THE ROAD! CHIYO-CHAN IS THE ONLY ONE LEFT TO SAVE, SO LETS MAKE THIS COUNT, EVERYONE!
